# Syndiqo Tower

Syndiqo Tower is an interactive 3D apartment-building experience published by Syndiqo. It lets visitors orbit a procedural WebGL tower and compare 12 illustrative residences by floor, bedrooms, area, orientation, view, floor plan, and release status.

## Canonical URLs

- Experience: https://tower.syndiqo.ma/
- Syndiqo: https://syndiqo.ma/

## Important facts

- The apartment building, availability, and property prices are illustrative demo content.
- The real-time model is rendered with Three.js and React Three Fiber; it is not a video.
- A separate $29 digital buyer pack is sold through a secure Polar checkout.
- Buying the digital pack does not sell or reserve real property.
